Estimates cut-points in ordinal model (imposex assessments)

Source: R/proportional_odds_functions.R
ordinal_theta_est.Rd

Estimates cut-points in ordinal model (imposex assessments)

Usage

ordinal_theta_est(data, theta = NULL, ref_level = NULL, calc_vcov = FALSE)

Arguments

data

individual ordinal data (e.g. for imposex assessments)

theta

an (optional) set of intial parameter values for theta; defaults to NULL

ref_level

an (optional) reference level for parameter estimation; defaults to a index with intermediate levels of imposex

calc_vcov

logical specifying whether to calculate the covariance matrix of the parameter estimates; defaults to FALSE
